178	    """The bare identifiers an Obsidian expression names: quoted strings, regex literals,

181	    property's, so the name after it is checked."""
182	    text = _unquoted(expression)
183	    text = re.sub(r'"[^"]*"', " ", text)
184	    text = re.sub(r"'[^']*'", " ", text)
185	    text = re.sub(r"#[^\n]*", " ", text)

193	        if match.start() and text[match.start() - 1] == ".":
194	            if _dot_root(text, match.start() - 1) != "note":

197	            continue

207	    """A property named under `properties:`, `order:`, `property:` or `summaries:`, where a
208	    hyphen is part of the name; a `file.`, `formula.` or `this.` prefix is never reported, while
209	    the name after a `note.` prefix is checked."""
210	    name = _unquoted(name).strip()
211	    if not name:
212	        return []
213	    root, _, rest = name.partition(".")
214	    if root in BASE_MEMBER_ROOTS:
215	        return []
216	    if root == "note" and rest:
217	        return [rest]
218	    return [name]

222	    """Every property `text` names, tagged as a plain name or an expression: keys under
223	    `properties:` and `summaries:`, entries of `order:`, the `property:` of a `sort` or
224	    `groupBy`, and filter and formula expressions. A nested `and:`/`or:`/`not:` group names no
225	    property; its items, or its inline expression, do."""

229	    while i < len(lines):

231	        stripped = raw.strip()
232	        indent = len(raw) - len(raw.lstrip())
233	        i += 1
234	        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
235	            continue
236	        header = BASE_HEADER.match(stripped)
237	        if not header:
238	            continue
239	        key, rest = header.group(1), header.group(2).strip()
240	        if key == "order" and rest.startswith("["):
241	            for entry in rest.strip("[]").split(","):
242	                named.append(("name", entry.strip()))
243	            continue

245	        while i < len(lines):

247	            content = line.strip()
248	            if content and not content.startswith("#"):

252	            i += 1

254	            child = min((depth for depth, _ in block), default=indent)
255	            for depth, content in block:
256	                if depth == child and ":" in content and not content.startswith("-"):
257	                    named.append(("name", content.split(":", 1)[0].strip()))
258	        elif key == "order":
259	            for _, content in block:
260	                if content.startswith("- "):
261	                    named.append(("name", content[2:].strip()))
262	        elif key in ("sort", "groupBy"):
263	            for _, content in block:
264	                match = BASE_PROPERTY.search(content)
265	                if match:
266	                    named.append(("name", match.group(1).strip()))
267	        else:
268	            if rest:

270	            for _, content in block:

criteria and cannot be changed.

Work in this order: read what the goal touches; run `check` once to see what fails; make the
smallest change that can make it pass; run `check`; repeat. Stop when `check` is green, or
when you cannot make it green within the budget, and return the report through the
`final_result` function: changed (the paths you wrote or edited, in order), did (what you
changed and why, one fact per item, each naming a path), check (green or red), failing (test
names if red), unsure (what you could not determine or verify).

Rules: change only what the goal needs; prefer `edit` over `write` for existing files; never
work around a failing test by changing what it asserts; no commentary outside the report.
